_comment: SHOSMED LF3 FINAL REVIEW PACK. Implemented 18 November 2026: the last ten
unreviewed chemistry questions and three supplied biology questions.
HOW THE IDS WERE VERIFIED. The brief supplied an expected mapping and asked
that it be confirmed against the full stems and all four options rather than
inferred from numbering or answer patterns. Every one of the thirteen records
was matched on its stored stem, its four stored option texts and the content
the brief's per-item instructions anchor on, and every edit in this pass is
anchored on text that had to be present byte for byte before anything was
written. All thirteen expected ids were confirmed.
ANSWER LETTERS. The eight solid-state items do not expose a stored key in the
export, so the brief supplied scientifically determined letters and asked that
any disagreement be reported before a key was changed. All thirteen stored
keys AGREE with the supplied letters, so no key was changed and there is no
disagreement to report.
A1-A8: A STORAGE GAP, NOT AN EXPORT ARTIFACT. All eight stored explanations
were bare prose containing no markup at all: no keyed heading, no 'Why the
other choices are wrong' heading and no distractor paragraphs. The structure
was genuinely absent from the records, so each explanation was rebuilt ONCE,
with an unlettered keyed heading matching the keyed option and exactly three
labelled distractor paragraphs. Nothing was duplicated, and none of the eight
gained an educational-point block, a Bottom Line or a table.
UI LABELS. 'Back to Dashboard', 'Unanswered' and 'Report an issue' appear in
NO stored field anywhere in the bank; all 629 biology and 485 chemistry
records were searched. They are interface text and are not counted here as
stored-content corrections.
PRESENTATION DECISIONS, recorded rather than silently applied:
- Keyed-heading style is per item and was preserved: B1 and B5 keep their
LETTERED keyed headings, B2, B3 and B4 keep their unlettered ones, and the
eight rebuilt items get unlettered headings as the brief specifies.
- A7's option C is kept verbatim as the brief requires, and it contains an em
dash: 'Carbon dioxide (CO2) — "dry ice"' (its quotes are straight, not
curly). Because a keyed heading must reproduce its option, A7's new heading
carries that em dash too. This is the only place in this pass where new
text contains an em dash, and it is inherited from official option text
rather than written. A6's and A7's own explanation em dashes were removed
by their replacement mains, so the pack goes from three em dashes to two,
both in A7.
- B3's existing diagram label and its surrounding div are untouched; only the
arrow sequence inside it was replaced, with the brief's own arrows.
subject: chemistry and biology

presentation_preserved.educational_points: 20 points in 5 blocks (B1 five, B2 five, B3 three, B4 two, B5 five); none added to A1-A8
presentation_preserved.bottom_lines: 4, in B1, B2, B3 and B4; B5 has none and gained none; A1-A8 gained none
presentation_preserved.tables: 2, in B2 and B3; none added to A1-A8
presentation_preserved.distractor_paragraphs: 15 before, 39 now, the complete pack of 13 x 3
presentation_preserved.keyed_heading_style: per item: B1 and B5 LETTERED, B2, B3, B4 and the eight rebuilt items unlettered
presentation_preserved.distractor_headings: every heading reproduces its own option text, in all thirteen items
presentation_preserved.entities_and_quotes: the pack stores no HTML entity and no curly quote; A7 and A8 use straight double quotes, and the headings that reproduce those options use them too

notes: A4's existing 4 + 4 + 4 nearest-neighbour description was retained as the brief instructs: it describes layers parallel to a cubic face and is not a numerical error. Counting close-packed layers instead gives 6 + 3 + 3, also twelve.
A1's unqualified 3550 degree C melting point and A6's 'most below 200 degree C' cutoff were removed and not replaced with another unqualified temperature.
No source reference, URL or implementation instruction appears in any student-facing field.
Earlier batches keep whatever approval status they already had; nothing here reopens them.
Structural and consistency checks establish scope and presentation. They do not establish scientific accuracy, which rests on the content review itself.

recorded under 'also_edited' rather than in its display map. The result
